categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in various locations. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlement, and property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
